steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Compute. Each figure is recomputed from its source, not copied from last month.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: High risk with no response
findings.fix: Add the response and its owner

findings.title: Summary figure does not match its source

outcome.notChecked: Forecast accuracy beyond the stated inputs.

pros: Checks a figure that does not match its source, a schedule position with no forecast, and a risk rated high with no response.
cons: Not checked: Forecast accuracy beyond the stated inputs.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-pm-monthly-project-report skill on the records for this review.
